Settings
Default model Claude Opus 4.6
The model the assistant uses when a mode-specific model isn't set.
Plan-mode model Claude Sonnet 4.6
The model used in plan mode. Falls back to the default model when unset.
Execute-mode model DeepSeek V4 Flash
The model used in execute mode. Falls back to the default model when unset.
Commit-message model Fast default
The model that writes commit messages. Falls back to a fast default when unset.
Compaction model Fast default
The model that summarizes older messages when the conversation nears its context limit. Falls back to a fast default when unset.
Mode Execute
Plan mode researches and proposes without editing files; execute mode writes code.
Reasoning effort Maximum (XL)
How hard the assistant thinks, set per mode using each mode's model-native levels (e.g. high/xhigh); also scales the agent loop budget.
Max tool iterations 100
Upper bound on the tool calls the assistant runs in one turn before it pauses for you.
Auto-fix On
After AI edits, re-run type-check and lint and feed any errors back so the assistant fixes them.
Auto-commit Every 60s
Automatically commit your work a set number of seconds after the last file change — on by default (5s; 0 = off), and it waits until the assistant finishes its turn before committing. Each change restarts the countdown, then it pauses after committing so a clean tree is never re-committed.
Hooks In project settings
Shell commands that run before tool actions and can gate them — for example previewing a change before the assistant overwrites or deletes a file. Configure them in your project's agent settings file.
Auto-approve commands Off
Skip the 'Proceed?' confirmation before the assistant runs a bulk/destructive command (a hard reset, a recursive delete, an in-place edit). Network access still follows the project's allowlist unless Full access is on.
Notification sounds 3 of 9 events enabled
Per-event notification sounds for responses, errors, file changes, and more.
Timestamps Off
Show the time on every chat message and event. Off by default; your own messages and critical events always show it. This device only.
